scenarios.title: Graph debugger opens with trusted-network warning and core controls
browser_cases: real Go startup, filtering, metrics, semantics, forces and viewport
scenarios.notes: Browser automation asserts loading, filtering, metrics, semantic controls, force reset and viewport changes.

scenarios.title: Search, tag selection and overview reset keep navigation local to the current graph
browser_cases: real Go inspector, references, search, tag filtering and deselection
scenarios.notes: Browser automation follows search results, tag filtering and overview reset through the real graph UI.

scenarios.title: Simulated principals and trash toggles rescope the visible graph and suspend refresh
browser_cases: real Go visibility and trash filters, refresh disabled in simulation
scenarios.notes: The graph UI and the snapshot service both enforce the scoped view and trash inclusion contract.

scenarios.title: Semantic overlays and force controls adjust the current view without discarding filters
browser_cases: real Go startup, filtering, metrics, semantics, forces and viewport
refresh completion preserves semantic and filter settings
scenarios.notes: Current direct evidence is browser-side. No Go test currently asserts the client-state preservation path.

scenarios.title: Aggregate clusters can expand into direct members and suppress aggregate-only actions
browser_cases: aggregated cluster expansion, member navigation and disabled aggregate actions
scenarios.notes: The browser case covers cluster drill-down and aggregate refresh restrictions.

scenarios.title: Diagnostics stay scoped, deduplicated and navigable from the current view or selection
browser_cases: diagnostic scope, target navigation, retry, versions and alignment
scenarios.notes: Browser and Go tests both cover scoped diagnostics, selected-node drill-down and fresh target sets.

scenarios.title: Detail and neighbourhood failures stay visible, distinct from empty state, and retryable
browser_cases: selection errors end loading; slow navigation cannot revive cleared inspector
diagnostic scope, target navigation, retry, versions and alignment
API failure, retry and error dismissal
scenarios.notes: The browser cases distinguish loading, failure and retry state. The service tests cover error envelopes and supporting data failures.

scenarios.title: Slow overview, search and node replies cannot repopulate a newer view
browser_cases: selection errors end loading; slow navigation cannot revive cleared inspector
slow overview cannot overwrite principal simulation
search reply cannot repopulate results after changing principal
scenarios.notes: The stale-reply behaviour is browser-audited. The Go static-asset test only checks that the abort and request-generation code paths remain present.

scenarios.title: Embedding refresh supports selected, visible and full scopes with confirmation and worker feedback
browser_cases: refresh selected/visible/full confirmation and error handling
refresh completion preserves semantic and filter settings
scenarios.notes: The browser suite asserts request scope, confirmation handling and worker-error feedback.

scenarios.title: Exports follow the current filtered view and disable bounded formats when nothing is visible
browser_cases: real Go PNG SVG JSON exports, metadata boundaries and URL cleanup
empty graph supports pointer hover, click and export controls
scenarios.notes: PNG, SVG and JSON download paths are browser-audited, with Go tests covering the server-side export contracts.

scenarios.title: Pointer, wheel and touch gestures support hover, pick and zoom without pinch misselection
browser_cases: large graph Points picking/hover and pinch/cancel never selects
empty graph supports pointer hover, click and export controls
scenarios.notes: The browser case drives real Three.js pointer behaviour. The Go static-asset test keeps the deselection branch in the embedded scene code.

scenarios.title: Empty, failed and WebGL-unavailable graph states surface clear fallback messaging
browser_cases: WebGL unavailable produces a visible diagnostic
API failure, retry and error dismissal
empty graph supports pointer hover, click and export controls
scenarios.notes: WebGL fallback is browser-only. Go tests cover the degraded HTTP states that feed the UI.

scenarios.title: The sidebar keeps legend and live telemetry visible during graph inspection
scenarios.notes: The sidebar legend and telemetry fields are implemented and documented, but no direct automated assertion currently checks their rendered values.

scenarios.title: Named controls and keyboard activation remain available for non-canvas navigation
browser_cases: diagnostic scope, target navigation, retry, versions and alignment
real Go startup, filtering, metrics, semantics, forces and viewport
real Go PNG SVG JSON exports, metadata boundaries and URL cleanup
scenarios.notes: Browser automation uses labelled controls and keyboard activation for diagnostics. This is not a full accessibility or screen-reader audit.

scenarios.title: Re-entering the debugger does not retain stale overlay UI from a previous session
browser_cases: scene disposal stops animation and removes overlay DOM
scenarios.notes: Current evidence is the browser teardown case. No dedicated Go test asserts client teardown behaviour.

scenarios.title: Opening the access manager requires an explicit administrator bearer for API actions
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
scenarios.notes: The browser case covers login denial and successful admin entry. Go tests cover route ownership and auth failures.

scenarios.title: Admin bearer and one-time credentials stay in volatile tab state and are cleared on lock or close
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
admin buttons, errors, rename, rotation, copy, Escape and stale session responses
scenarios.notes: The browser suite checks lock, secret clearing, Escape handling and the absence of localStorage and sessionStorage use.

scenarios.title: Principals view shows lifecycle state, namespace scope and server warnings
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
scenarios.notes: The browser case proves the principals view renders after login. The Go test proves warning and lifecycle payloads, but no browser case checks every rendered pill.

scenarios.title: Create view can issue a principal from an editable preset access policy
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
scenarios.notes: Browser automation exercises preset selection and create submission. It does not directly assert every live summary update in the form.

scenarios.title: Create and rotate actions reveal a one-time credential bundle that can be copied once
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
admin buttons, errors, rename, rotation, copy, Escape and stale session responses
scenarios.notes: Browser automation checks create, rotate, copy, Escape and secret clearing.

scenarios.title: Operators can rename, enable, disable, rotate, revoke and delete principals with confirmation
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
admin buttons, errors, rename, rotation, copy, Escape and stale session responses
scenarios.notes: The browser suite covers the operator flows. Go tests cover the server lifecycle contract and failure boundaries.

scenarios.title: Activity shows recent access-management events without revealing bearer secrets
browser_cases: real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
scenarios.notes: The Go test covers the 50-event bound. The browser case checks that activity renders and does not leak the revealed secret.

scenarios.title: Action failures are visible and stale replies from an earlier session are ignored
browser_cases: admin buttons, errors, rename, rotation, copy, Escape and stale session responses
real admin authentication, principal lifecycle, credential secrecy and activity
scenarios.notes: Browser automation covers visible action errors and stale-session protection. The Go test covers the underlying API error envelopes.

scenarios.title: Create access preview shows effective read and write scope and admin risk warnings
scenarios.notes: The live create-form summary and admin warning are implemented and documented, but no direct automated assertion currently checks the changing summary text.
